title: If μ_V = θ H^n⌞M, the varifold tangent plane at x is the unique approximate tangent plane of (M, θ) at x
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U, and H := μHE[n]. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be H-null-measurable, and let θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ > 0 on M and θ H-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N. Suppose μ_V(B) = ∫⁻_{M∩B} ofReal(θ) dH for every Borel B. Let x ∈ ℝ^N and T ∈ G(N,n) with HasTangentPlane V x T (θ(x)) (Simon 8, Def. 1.1). Then for every S ∈ G(N,n): M has approximate tangent space S.plane at x with respect to θ (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane, Simon Ch. 3, 1.7) if and only if S = T.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n]) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → V.weight B = ∫⁻ y in M ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂μHE[n]) → HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x) → ∀ S : Grassmannian N n, Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane ↔ S = T
